summary: Iter79 UI-only regression against external URL after mass color-token swap (colors.primary → colors.accent). Frontend Playwright smoke @ 390x844 with applereview@cheerplanner.app: (1) All main screens render WITHOUT red screen — Dashboard, Athletes, Expenses, Competitions, Schedule, Teams, Settings, and Team Hub. (2) Schedule tab header shows compact 'Event' add-button (testID add-schedule, bg rgb(37,99,235) = CheerPlanner blue) and 'Select' button (sched-enter-select); Type filter row shows the dashed '+ Type' chip (sched-filter-type-add), tapping it opens the AddTypeModal (add-type-modal) with name field + color palette + Cancel/Add — verified in screenshot. (3) Seasons screen (/seasons): Create modal opens under KeyboardAvoidingView; season-name TextInput visible and typeable; Start/End are DateField pickers rendered with the MM-DD-YYYY placeholder ( calendar glyph). After programmatically setting ISO 2026-01-15 / 2026-06-20, the visible labels correctly render '01-15-2026' / '06-20-2026'. Season created (row shows '01-15-2026 → 06-20-2026 Active'), Edit modal reopens with dates prefilled MM-DD-YYYY, then deleted for cleanup. (4) Custom theme follow-through: picked theme-preset-gold_black → add-schedule and add-athlete-btn re-colored to gold rgb(234,179,8). Reverted to cheerplanner preset. (5) /schedule/new loads with schedule-save testID and MM-DD-YYYY dates. **One issue**: Seasons screen buttons DO NOT follow the custom theme — seasons-add stayed rgb(0,124,255) while add-schedule turned gold. Root cause: seasons.tsx uses `StyleSheet.create` with static `colors.accent` from /src/theme (raw #007CFF), instead of the themed accent via useThemedStyles(makeStyles). This is also why seasons-add (rgb(0,124,255)) differs from the standardized CheerPlanner blue rgb(37,99,235) that other buttons use even with the default theme.

ui_bugs.issue: Seasons + add button, season-create-btn, season-edit-save, and season-rollover-confirm all use static `colors.accent` from /src/theme (StyleSheet.create) instead of themed `c.accent`. Result: (a) these buttons stay at raw #007CFF (rgb(0,124,255)) rather than the standardized CheerPlanner accent rgb(37,99,235) that themed buttons use; (b) when user selects a non-default preset like gold_black, all other primary buttons recolor but Seasons buttons stay blue. Refactor styles to use `useThemedStyles(makeStyles)` and pull `c.accent` from ThemePalette (same pattern as (tabs)/schedule.tsx).

issues: Primary buttons use hard-coded static blue and do not react to custom theme selection (see ui_bug above).

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/seasons.tsx, migrate `const styles = StyleSheet.create({...})` (uses static `colors.accent`) to `const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles)` with `makeStyles = (c: ThemePalette) => ({...})` so seasons-add, addBtn.backgroundColor, activeBadge.backgroundColor, activeBadgeText.color, confirm.backgroundColor, pickRowOn.borderColor/backgroundColor, kindChipOn.borderColor/backgroundColor, kindChipTextOn.color, and MenuItem's icon color all follow the user's custom accent (same pattern already used in (tabs)/schedule.tsx). Also aligns Seasons blue to the app-standard CheerPlanner accent.
critical_code_review_comments: components/DateField.tsx (web path) hides the native <input type=date> at opacity 0 with pointerEvents:'none' and calls showPicker() from the outer Pressable — clean, and confirmed on Chrome that MM-DD-YYYY label always renders regardless of browser locale. Good.

components/FilterChipRow.tsx correctly detects overflow via onLayout + onContentSizeChange and shows a chevron scroll hint. The trailing dashed '+ Type' chip works (verified) and testID pattern `${prefix}-add` is consistent.
app/(tabs)/schedule.tsx uses useThemedStyles(makeStyles) with c.accent for the add/select buttons — matches the theme-follow requirement. Type-filter add flow works end-to-end (add-type-modal opens).

app/seasons.tsx is the ONLY main screen that still uses raw StyleSheet.create with `colors.accent`. Migrating to useThemedStyles keeps consistency with the rest of the app. This also happens to be why its blue is #007CFF while other themed buttons use rgb(37,99,235).

Non-blocking console warning across all screens: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` — a stale prop somewhere in the tree (react-native-web upstream). Not caused by this iteration.

rca_of_issue: Seasons theme-follow miss: /app/frontend/app/seasons.tsx line 207 uses `const styles = StyleSheet.create({...})` where the color literals reference the module-level `colors` import from '@/src/theme' (line 8). That module exports the STATIC palette (default #007CFF blue). Themed screens use `const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles)` where `makeStyles(c)` receives the current ThemePalette from ThemeContext, so `c.accent` reflects the user's selection. Fix is mechanical: convert styles to a factory `(c: ThemePalette) => ({...})` and switch every `colors.accent` inside styles to `c.accent` (leave direct icon color usages like `Ionicons color={colors.accent}` — those need `useTheme()` hook or pass the palette via a hook). Rest of the app already uses this pattern (schedule.tsx, teams.tsx, etc.).
